name: Sonicos WhatsApp Bot
description: A Go WhatsApp bot built with whatsmeow, SQLite/PostgreSQL, optional Redis, and a password-protected web onboarding dashboard.

DATABASE_DRIVER.description: Optional database driver (sqlite3 or pgx). Automatically switches to pgx when DATABASE_URL starts with postgres:// or postgresql://.

DATABASE_URL.description: Database URL. Set a Supabase, Neon, or Heroku PostgreSQL URL for persistent WhatsApp sessions and bot features with zero volumes or Redis; leave default for ephemeral SQLite.

REDIS_URL.description: Optional Redis connection URL. If omitted, moderation, shields, and !sreact automatically persist in your SQL database.

DASHBOARD_PASSWORD.description: Password (alphanumeric or numeric) required to unlock the web onboarding dashboard for QR or phone-number WhatsApp linking.
